module: Manages the career's introduction popups (tutorial and contextual help): remembers which ones have already been seen (flags saved in <profile>/career/tutorialData.json), opens them via ui_popup from /gameplay/tutorials/pages/, and queues those that would arrive during a tutorial "damaged vehicle" popup. Also exposes named functions (showWelcomeSplashscreen, onCareerTuningStarted, onEnterCargoOverviewScreen...) that serve as hooks or direct calls to display the associated popup only once.
notes: Functions are dynamically generated from the internal introPopupTable table: showWelcomeSplashscreen (welcome), showBeforeDrivingSplashscreen (driving), showCrashRecoverSplashScreen (crashRecover), onRefuelingStartTransaction (refueling), onAvailableMissionsSentToUi (missions), showPostMissionSplash (postMission), onCareerTuningStarted (tuning), garageModeStartStep (garage), showLogbookSplash (logbook), showTutorialOverSplash (finishing, logbook, leagues, performanceIndex), onEnterCargoOverviewScreen (delivery/cargoScreen), onComputerInsurance (insurance), onVehiclePaintingUiOpened (vehiclePainting). Other entries (addWalkingModeLogbookEntry, addCamerasLogbookEntry, showTraversalSplashScreen, showBasicTutorialComplete, onVehicleBought) exist but open no popup (empty list). These functions do not appear in the automatic page list.
introPopup marks the flag as seen before opening, then calls ui_popup.openPopupById with root /gameplay/tutorials/pages/.

If the tutorial is active, a crash occurred and the damage popup (v2/damagedVehicle, v2/damagedVehicleTimeTrial, v2/damagedVehicleCareer) is not yet closed, the requested popup is queued and reopened when the next one closes.
The allTutorialFlags field is defined at the end of the file; showAllSplashscreensAndLogbookEntries resets all these flags to false before redisplaying everything.

allTutorialFlags.desc: List of known popup ids (welcome, driving, crashRecover, bigmap, refueling, missions, tuning, insurance, leagues, etc.).

setFlagsTable.desc: Replaces the whole "popup seen" flags table.

flagsTable.desc: New table; nil gives an empty table.

getTutorialFlag.desc: Reads a popup's flag (true if seen).

wasIntroPopupsSeen.desc: Indicates whether all the listed popups have already been seen.

returns.desc: true if all have their flag (also true for an empty list).

introPopup.desc: Opens an intro popup. Without force, does nothing if it has already been seen. May be queued after a tutorial damage popup.

force.desc: If true, ignores the "already seen" flag.

introPopupSequence.desc: Opens several popups in sequence (ui_popup.openPopupsByIds) and marks all ids as seen.

force.desc: If false or nil, only marks the pages not yet seen; the sequence is opened in all cases.

showNonTutorialWelcomeSplashscreen.desc: Displays (forced) the welcome popups without tutorial: welcomeNoTutorial, leagues, performanceIndex, logbook.

showAllSplashscreensAndLogbookEntries.desc: Resets all flags to false then redisplays all the welcome popups and all the popups of the internal table (useful to review the help).

drawDebugFunctions.desc: Draws the "Intro Popups" debug imgui menu: review all, mark all unseen, per-popup checkboxes, content edit button.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Load hook: reads the flags from tutorialData.json of the current profile.

onSaveCurrentProfile.desc: Profile save hook: writes the flags to tutorialData.json.

onIntroPopupCareerClosed.desc: Hook emitted when a popup closes: if it is a damage popup, marks the closing, then reopens the first queued popup.
